nodes.description: Mapping of holder addresses to token balances; mutated on transfers, mints and burns.
Whitelist mapping controlled by the owner through multiTransfer/increaseAllowance; bypasses burnTokenCheck restrictions.
Blacklist mapping toggled in addApprove and burnTokenCheck to block transfers.
Threshold amount set when the owner self-transfers; gates non-whitelisted transfers.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance updated by _approve.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Privileged owner address used in access-control requires throughout the contract.
Secondary privileged address that can be silently reassigned via decreaseAllowance and burnTokenCheck.
Hardcoded Uniswap router address used as an allowed transfer recipient.
Constructor setting name, symbol, decimals, owner/safeOwner and minting the initial supply.
ERC20 transfer; routes through _approveCheck so blacklist/whitelist logic applies.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists receivers and grants them infinite router allowance.
Sets allowance of spender to caller via _approve.
Transfers on behalf of sender using allowance, decreasing the caller allowance.
Owner-only function that whitelists an array of addresses and clears their blacklist flag.
Owner-only function that reassigns _safeOwner to an arbitrary address (privilege transfer).
Owner-only function that blacklists an array of addresses and removes their whitelist flag.
Internal transfer that subtracts from sender and adds to recipient balances.
Public mint function guarded only by msg.sender == _owner; increases supply and owner balance.
Internal allowance setter writing to _allowances and emitting Approval.
Internal transfer guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier; mutates balances.
Modifier implementing owner/safeOwner bypass, whitelist/blacklist gating and _sellAmount threshold logic.
View returning the balance of an account.
View returning the allowance between owner and spender.
Internal burn reducing account balance and total supply.
External caller address; compared against _owner for privileges and used as transfer origin.
Unchecked balance subtraction path (_balances[sender].sub(...)) in _transfer/_approveCheck, an arithmetic risk.
multiTransfer grants max-uint allowance to _unirouter/whitelisted addresses, an unbounded approval risk.
Modifier burnTokenCheck silently blacklists senders, a centralized state-manipulation risk.
decreaseAllowance reassigns _safeOwner, a hidden ownership/privilege transfer backdoor.
_mint is externally callable and only gated by owner check, a privileged supply-inflation risk.
_sellAmount is set inside the modifier on owner self-transfer, controlling transfer gating.
Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Token amount parameter used by transfer/transferFrom/_transfer.
Number of receivers in multiTransfer that additionally get whitelisted and approved.
Array of receiver addresses in multiTransfer and whitelist/blacklist functions.
Array of amounts paired with receivers in multiTransfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom/_transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve/allowance.
New safeOwner address parameter of decreaseAllowance.
Account address parameter of _mint/_burn/balanceOf.
Owner address parameter of _approve and allowance.
Loop index iterating receivers in multiTransfer.
Loop index iterating receivers in increaseAllowance.
Loop index iterating receivers in addApprove.

edges.reason: Caller msg.sender acts as transfer origin through _msgSender, so external input drives transfer execution.
multiTransfer is gated only by require(msg.sender == _owner), an owner-controlled privileged path.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner to whitelist addresses.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner and then reassigns _safeOwner.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner to blacklist addresses.
_mint requires msg.sender == _owner before inflating supply and owner balance.
transfer dispatches to _approveCheck which performs the actual balance movement.
transferFrom dispatches to _approveCheck to move balances.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the caller allowance.
multiTransfer loops and calls transfer for each receiver.
multiTransfer calls _approve granting max allowance to _unirouter for whitelisted receivers.
multiTransfer writes true into _whiteAddress for receivers below approvecount.
_approveCheck is guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier whose branch logic decides whether the body runs.
_transfer subtracts amount from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient].
_approveCheck mutates _balances using SafeMath sub/add, an arithmetic-sensitive state update.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
_burn subtracts amount from _balances[account].
_burn subtracts amount from _totalSupply.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply, inflating supply under owner control.
_mint credits _balances[_owner] with newly created tokens.
decreaseAllowance overwrites _safeOwner with an arbitrary address, transferring privilege.
burnTokenCheck reads and can reassign _safeOwner to the recipient when owner state matches.
burnTokenCheck sets _sellAmount on owner self-transfer, controlling the transfer threshold.
burnTokenCheck blacklists the sender when the amount is below _sellAmount.
burnTokenCheck updates _whiteAddress when blacklisting a sender.
_transfer performs balance subtraction that can underflow if invariants are broken.
_approveCheck performs balance subtraction on sender balances.
multiTransfer grants max-uint allowance to _unirouter for whitelisted receivers.
burnTokenCheck can silently blacklist any sender, a centralized restriction operation.
decreaseAllowance reassigns _safeOwner enabling a hidden privilege/ownership backdoor.
Publicly declared _mint mints tokens by owner only but can inflate supply arbitrarily.
burnTokenCheck assigns _sellAmount, changing which transfers are allowed.
recipient parameter flows into transfer and onward to balance updates.
amount parameter flows into transfer and the safe-math subtraction.
amount parameter is the operand of the balance subtraction in _transfer.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom and its allowance decrement.
spender parameter flows into approve and _approve.
approvecount parameter decides which receivers are whitelisted and infinitely approved.
receivers array parameter is iterated over in multiTransfer.
amounts array parameter supplies the transfer amounts in multiTransfer.
safeOwner parameter becomes the new privileged _safeOwner.
account parameter receives minted tokens in _mint.
owner parameter is the allowance holder written by _approve.
loop index i controls iteration over receivers in multiTransfer.
loop index i controls iteration over receivers in increaseAllowance.
loop index i controls iteration over receivers in addApprove.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter is local to transfer and should be absorbed into the transfer function node.
amount parameter is local to transfer/transferFrom and should be absorbed into the transfer function node.
approvecount parameter is local to multiTransfer and merges into the multiTransfer function node.
receivers parameter is local to multiTransfer and merges into the multiTransfer function node.
amounts parameter is local to multiTransfer and merges into the multiTransfer function node.
sender parameter is local to transferFrom and merges into the transferFrom function node.
spender parameter is local to approve and merges into the approve function node.
safeOwner parameter is local to decreaseAllowance and merges into the decreaseAllowance function node.
account parameter is local to _mint and merges into the _mint function node.
owner parameter is local to _approve and merges into the _approve function node.
loop index local variable belongs to multiTransfer and merges into that function node.
loop index local variable belongs to increaseAllowance and merges into that function node.
loop index local variable belongs to addApprove and merges into that function node.
